title: ui_session
summary: MSUI now applies current Benilla's one squared service gate (30.864 yd²) to vendor, gossip, quest, trainer, taxi, bank, mailbox and binder sessions, as well as the world service cursor. Each always-pumped lifecycle keeps an established session while the player transform is temporarily unavailable, but client-side closes it with no wire when the bound NPC/game object despawns or crosses the shared boundary. Interaction windows now feed live portraits from their bound NPC source; accepted taxi travel closes the NPC map and its later spline no longer reopens that window.

openItems.text: The gossip menu has no out-of-range/despawn auto-close - range is checked only at open (Program.Gossip.cs); walking away leaves the menu up until manually closed.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: UpdateGossipLifecycle now closes the menu on source despawn or shared service-range exit.

openItems.text: Trainer, taxi, mail, and bank sessions have no range/despawn lifecycle guard either (open-time range checks only in Program.Trainer.cs; nothing polls after open).
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: always-pumped trainer, taxi and bank guards were added; the pre-existing mail guard was moved onto the same squared service law.

openItems.text: Range-law inconsistency: the vendor guard uses the byte-verified 5.5556 yd while the quest guard reuses GossipInteractDistance = 6f - Benilla applies the single 5.5556 service gate to every session so window-close and cursor-gray agree.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: NpcSessionUiLaw now owns 30.864 yd² and is consumed by every NPC/mail/binder session plus WorldCursorUiLaw.

openItems.text: No open-NPC portrait feed equivalent (Benilla's InteractNpc collapse for the interaction window's unit-model portrait slot); MSUI interaction windows do not point a live portrait at the NPC.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: gossip, quest, vendor, trainer, taxi and bank render their live bound NPC portrait; object-only mailboxes correctly have no unit portrait.
